اعتطفنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَطَفْنَا (iʕtaṭafnā) /iʕ.ta.tˤaf.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# اُعْتُطِفْنَا (uʕtuṭifnā) /uʕ.tu.tˤif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
